frozen_predictor.source: argine.research2.r2_bridge01.retention_policies.PredictedProtectPolicy wraps one DecayedTransitionPredictor(n_experts, decay=0.99) per layer; identical to the predictor frozen in R2-BRIDGE-01's PHASE1-SELECTION-FREEZE.json (predictor_identity: 'decayed_transition/decay=0.99'), itself validated causally in R2-10.

frozen_retention_mechanism.name: PredictedProtectPolicy
frozen_retention_mechanism.note_on_bonus_configs: build_bridge_configs() also defines predictor_retention_score at bonus=0.0/1.0/4.0; R2-11 explicitly does NOT evaluate those configs (per instruction #4/#23 -- only PredictedProtectPolicy and B_selected(M) are in scope).
frozen_retention_mechanism.source: The exact mechanism selected prospectively in R2-BRIDGE-01 Phase 1 (PHASE1-SELECTION-FREEZE.json: classification DEV_RETENTION_SIGNAL_POSITIVE, selected_config_id='predicted_protect/budget=4294967296' pattern generalized across the 3 frozen budgets via build_bridge_configs()/make_policy()), then confirmed BRIDGE_POSITIVE on the R2-BRIDGE-01 holdout (BRIDGE_DECISION_RULE_APPLICATION.json, commit 58b36a1).

implementation_change_policy: Any implementation change required for correctness (e.g. a bugfix analogous to the Phase-2A.1 instrumentation repair) must be recorded as a separately audited instrumentation/implementation repair (see instrumentation_dependency.json) and must not alter scientific policy semantics, the causal boundary, or the predictor's decay/aging parameters.
